title: regional_scope_access.granted event payload (v1)
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 20.5/19e.20. Produced by epd2_organization_service.events.build_regional_scope_access_granted_event, and only ever emitted for access modes 2-5 (ancestor_scope/descendant_scope/delegated_cross_scope/temporary_supervision) via epd2_organization_service.application.record_regional_scope_access_grant - never for mode 1 (exact_scope, the ordinary default) or mode 6 (institutional_oversight_without_data_access, which grants no data access by definition). Minimum payload only: the evaluated OrganizationalScope (scope_type/scope_reference), which access mode applied, policy_version, effective_time, and recorded_at - never the requesting actor's identity beyond the envelope's own ActorRef.
